title: LLM Mini Experiment Tracker (personal)
content:
Mini experiment tracker - Ashley Kim (personal scratchpad)

Columns: experiment_id | date | model | prompt_template | lr | batch_size | quant | tokens_out | latency_p50_ms | cost_per_1k_tokens_usd | primary_metric | notes | status

EXP-001 | 2025-11-15 | redwood-3b | instruction-short | 1e-05 | 8 | int8 | 1024 | 120 | 0.024 | ppl=14.2 | quick smoke, int8 works, some repetition | completed
EXP-002 | 2025-11-18 | redwood-3b | instruction-long | 5e-06 | 4 | fp16 | 2048 | 95 | 0.045 | ppl=12.7 | slightly better quality, higher cost | completed
EXP-010 | 2026-01-05 | redwood-7b | few-shot-3 | 3e-06 | 2 | q4_0 | 512 | 210 | 0.055 | rougeL=0.62 | q4_0 lowers cost but increases latency; check batching | in_progress
EXP-014 | 2026-02-10 | redwood-7b | retrieval-aug | 3e-06 | 2 | q4_0 | 768 | 185 | 0.052 | acc@1=0.78 | retrieval helps; need eval on bigger prompt set | in_progress

Quick notes / hypotheses:
- int8 quant reduces cost ~30% on 3b but adds ~10-15% latency; acceptable for background tasks, not for low-p50 routes.
- q4_0 (7b) is promising for cost-sensitive workloads but variance in hallucination frequency - need targeted eval.
- few-shot templates improve accuracy on QA but multiply token cost; consider retrieval + shorter prompt to reduce tokens_out.

Next steps / TODO:
- [ ] Run batch of 50 eval prompts against EXP-010/014 with automated metrics (precision/recall/rouge/acc). Attach dataset to confluence page.
- [ ] Add per-route latency SLO targets and simulate with local load generator (see ENG-3421).
- [ ] Try prefix caching on repeated context patterns - measure cache hit rate and p50 improvement.
- [ ] Compare autoscaling impact on median latency for dedicated pools vs hosted API for the same model config.

Scratch:
- Short-run notes: 7b q4_0 p50 ~185ms for tokens_out 768 (CPU offload on one pod), cost estimate uses Redwood hosted pricing baseline.
- Questions: what is acceptable latency increase for 30% cost savings? Talk to product (Priya) for user-impact thresholds.

Links / refs:
- ENG-3421 (experiment tracking ticket)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/482 (batching changes used in EXP-010)
- Confluence: confluence:LLM-experiments-ashley

Notes to self: keep this mini-sheet intentionally small - use it for quick decisions and link to more formal sheets for final numbers.
